raw_segments.text: Coriolanus. Most sweet voices. Better it is to die, better to starve, than crave the higher
which first we do deserve. Why in this woolvish toad should I stand here to beg of hob and
dick that does appear their needless vouches? Custom calls me taut. What custom wills, in
all things should we dot? The dust on antique time would lie unswept and mountainous error
be too highly heaped for truth to appear. Rather than fool it so, let the high office
and the honor go to one that would do thus. I am half through. The one part suffered,
